nodes.name: good_unit_test.yaml
nodes.summary: Minimal 50 MW deterministic test scenario supplying project, tariff, FX, OPEX, CAPEX, tax, risk and financing-terms inputs to drive the project-finance model in unit tests. Used as a known-good fixture for asserting model outputs.

nodes.name: kalpitiya_lendercase_160m_fitted.yaml
nodes.summary: Full DutchBay (Kalpitiya) 159.6 MW lender-case scenario at 160 m hub height with an ERA5-fitted Weibull (A=8.259, k=2.664) driving wind-resource/AEP, CAPEX/OPEX, tax, debt sizing, returns, Monte-Carlo and sensitivity blocks. Primary bankability input deck for the model.

nodes.name: mullikulam_2x50mw_mannar.yaml
nodes.summary: Config-driven Mullikulam (Mannar) 2x50 MW wind-farm scenario using a Vestas V150-5.6 proxy at 125 m hub with an ERA5-fitted Weibull, defining resource/AEP, tariff/FX, CAPEX/OPEX, tax, financing, returns and risk inputs. Alternative-site lender deck for the model.

nodes.name: sensitivity_parameters_examples.yaml
nodes.summary: Example sensitivity-analysis suite listing tornado variables (CAPEX, tariff, OPEX, capacity factor) with base values and low/high percentage ranges. Serves as a template for the model's one-way sensitivity tooling.

nodes.name: test_base_scenario.yaml
nodes.summary: Baseline 50 MW test scenario providing project, tariff, FX, OPEX, CAPEX, tax, risk and financing-terms inputs for regression and unit testing of the project-finance engine. Acts as the canonical small-case input deck.
